examples.safetyNote: Generic ideal static OR-gate model, not a manufacturer-specific 74xx device. It uses a 50% supply threshold and ideal rail-to-rail output, and omits propagation delay, output drive limits, input leakage, logic-family thresholds, switching noise, and part ratings.

examples.title: Two-input XOR odd-parity checker
examples.objective: Use a generic ideal five-volt XOR gate to assert a current-limited LED when exactly one of two inputs is high; test all four combinations.
examples.acceptanceTest: tests/core.test.mjs: catalogue XOR parity checker asserts for odd parity only
examples.safetyNote: Generic ideal static XOR logic model, not a manufacturer-specific device. It uses a 50% supply threshold and ideal rail-to-rail output; propagation delay, output drive limits, input leakage, real logic-family thresholds, switching noise, and part ratings are omitted.

examples.title: Cross-coupled NOR SR latch
examples.objective: Build a two-NOR active-high SR latch with Q/Q̅ LED indicators; verify set, reset, state retention in the hold condition, and rejection of simultaneous set and reset.
examples.acceptanceTest: tests/core.test.mjs: catalogue NOR SR latch sets, resets, holds state, and blocks forbidden inputs
examples.safetyNote: Generic ideal static NOR latch. State retention is passed explicitly between analyses. It omits gate propagation delay, metastability, switch bounce, output loading beyond the LED resistor, and manufacturer-specific behavior.

examples.title: Positive-edge D flip-flop register

examples.safetyNote: Generic ideal positive-edge static model. Setup/hold timing, metastability, propagation delay, asynchronous preset/clear behavior, output loading beyond the LED resistor, and device-specific limits are not modeled.

examples.title: JK flip-flop toggle divider
